preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of acquaintance pairs m must be between 0 and 500,000.
The number of academic groups k must be between 2 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= k for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each student's group number c_i must be between 1 and k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in acquaintances)
preconditions.description: Each acquaintance pair (a_i, b_i) must consist of valid student indices and must not be the same student.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of valid pairs of groups that can be selected for the game.
